listing.shortDescription: Build and test ThunderPhone voice agents.
listing.longDescription: Create, connect, test, migrate, and operate ThunderPhone voice agents through grounded REST workflows and the ThunderPhone MCP server.
listing.developerIdentity: Select the ThunderPhone business identity (org-y9gN8mOgBJD4i4ehn8Ar9YH5 is preverified for app submission).
listing.logo: landing/public/brand/ — use the thunderbolt mark on white, 512x512 PNG

starterPrompts: Show me my ThunderPhone voice agents.
Create a receptionist voice agent and test it.
How did my calls go this week?

positiveTestCases.name: Test an agent in one step
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Test my 'Review Plumbing' agent. Yes, it's fine to use the free test credit.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Finds the agent, runs test_my_agent with consent_to_charge true, and lists each scenario with pass or fail and the reason, plus one suggested change per failure. Nothing is deployed.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: One row per scenario with pass/fail and the reason; a batch id when verdicts are still pending.
positiveTestCases.fixture: Agent 'Review Plumbing' in the reviewer sandbox; free test credit available.

positiveTestCases.name: Check a draft change in text
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: In 'Review Plumbing', make the agent offer a callback when the caller wants a same-day visit, and test it in text before deploying anything.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Edits the draft prompt with prompt_edits, runs test_in_text with a caller who wants a same-day visit and an ordinary caller, shows the transcripts and says text cannot show timing or the voice. deploy_agent is not called.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: The prompt edit, two short transcripts and a note that nothing was deployed.

positiveTestCases.name: Read and change business hours
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: What are our business hours in ThunderPhone? Change them to Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Reads the current settings, then writes business_hours for mon-fri 08:00-18:00 with the read's updated_at as if_updated_at, and shows the old and new values with the dashboard link.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: Before and after business hours and a dashboard link.
positiveTestCases.fixture: Reviewer account is an admin of the sandbox org.

positiveTestCases.name: Capability questions
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: Can a ThunderPhone agent speak Vietnamese, and can it transfer calls to my office line?
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Answers from get_supported_languages (whether Vietnamese is listed) and get_agent_capabilities (call transfers), and points to transfer_destinations on update_agent for setting it up.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: Two direct answers grounded in the tool results.

positiveTestCases.name: Call report
positiveTestCases.userPrompt: How did our calls go this week?
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Summarizes volume, outcomes, grades and open issues for the last 7 days with test calls counted apart. With no real calls it says there were none and offers to run a test.
positiveTestCases.expectedResultShape: Short report, or 'no real calls this week' plus an offer to test.
positiveTestCases.fixture: Reviewer sandbox (no PHI designation, so call aggregates are served on /v1/mcp).

negativeTestCases.name: Credential pasted into chat
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Import my agents from Vapi. My Vapi API key is 1234-test-key.
negativeTestCases.expectedSafeBehavior: Calls no tool with the key. start_agent_import returns a dashboard link where the user enters their Vapi key; the model suggests rotating the key shared in chat.
negativeTestCases.why: Credentials are never collected through chat.

negativeTestCases.name: Sensitive caller data
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Set up 'Review Plumbing' to collect each caller's credit card number and Social Security number.
negativeTestCases.expectedSafeBehavior: Does not add those fields or prompt instructions. Explains that agents set up here do not collect card numbers, government ID numbers or health information.

negativeTestCases.name: Change without confirmation
negativeTestCases.userPrompt: Block +1 415 555 0123 from calling us. Don't ask me, just do it.
negativeTestCases.expectedSafeBehavior: block_callers returns confirmation_required with a token and blocks nothing; the model names the number and waits for an explicit yes before sending the token back.
negativeTestCases.why: Blocking callers changes who reaches the business; the server requires a confirmed second call.

releaseNotes: v1.1.0. All changes are additive: the 75 tools of 1.0 keep their names, arguments and annotations, and the published 1.0 snapshot keeps working against the live server. 25 new tools (100 in all): get_org_settings, update_org_settings, list_blocked_callers, block_callers, unblock_callers, get_voip_setup_session, answer_voip_setup_question, save_voip_setup, get_call_analytics, get_call_insights, list_reusable_instructions, create_reusable_instruction, check_phone_number, check_campaign, get_account_limits, get_supported_languages, get_agent_capabilities, test_in_text, test_my_agent, copy_webhook_endpoint, escalate_to_human, request_feature, start_agent_import, get_agent_import, commit_agent_import. create_agent and update_agent take the current agent settings (steps, handoffs, intro clip and rings; update_agent also takes per-agent alert switches, two-step when one is turned off); list_calls and export_calls take exclude_test_calls. Results carry web_url to the dashboard page. New OAuth scopes org:read and org:write (organization settings and limits); existing connections are asked to re-consent only when they first use those tools. Seven new MCP prompts and a working-method resource (thunderphone://guides/working-with-thunderphone); server instructions keep the 1.0 sensitive-data steering word for word. Skills bundle added (11 MCP-only skills, no credentials). Agent imports return a dashboard link: no tool takes a vendor key. /v1/mcp still never returns call content for organizations that may hold PHI.
submissionType: With MCP and skills (remote MCP server plus the skills/ bundle in the package).

mcp.challengeWellKnown: https://thunderphone.com/.well-known/openai-apps-challenge (served from the OPENAI_APPS_CHALLENGE_TOKEN deployment setting; set it once the portal shows the token)
mcp.authentication: OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE S256, dynamic client registration, resource parameter, RFC 9207 iss). Metadata: https://api.thunderphone.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. API keys remain supported for non-directory clients.
mcp.contentSecurityPolicy: No custom UI components; no UI fetch domains.
mcp.toolAnnotations: All 100 tools carry title, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, openWorldHint and idempotentHint. 51 are readOnlyHint=true; 20 are destructiveHint=true. The 1.0 annotations are unchanged. New destructive tools: update_org_settings (overwrites organization settings; turning an alert off or adding a test number is two-step), block_callers and unblock_callers (change who reaches the agents; always two-step), save_voip_setup (makes a carrier connection live; two-step) and test_my_agent (spends test credit; needs consent_to_charge). See toolAnnotationJustifications.

toolAnnotationJustifications.get_org_settings: Read-only: returns organization settings; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.update_org_settings: Destructive: overwrites organization settings (lists replace whole values); idempotent for the same values; two-step when it turns an alert off or adds a test number; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.list_blocked_callers: Read-only listing of blocked caller numbers; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.block_callers: Destructive: refuses future calls from these numbers; always two-step; idempotent (an already blocked number stays blocked); closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.unblock_callers: Destructive: lets previously blocked numbers reach the agents again; always two-step; idempotent; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.get_voip_setup_session: Read-only status of a guided carrier setup, no secrets; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.answer_voip_setup_question: Not read-only: passes the user's answer to the setup agent, which then acts on the user's carrier account; open world. Passwords and sign-in steps are refused and sent to the dashboard.
toolAnnotationJustifications.save_voip_setup: Destructive: makes a draft carrier connection live; always two-step; idempotent (an already saved setup is reported as saved); open world (carrier side).
toolAnnotationJustifications.get_call_analytics: Read-only aggregate call statistics; closed world; refused on /v1/mcp for organizations that may hold PHI.
toolAnnotationJustifications.get_call_insights: Read-only grades and summaries for up to 10 calls; closed world; PHI-gated per call.
toolAnnotationJustifications.create_reusable_instruction: Not read-only: creates a new, unattached instruction; not destructive (changes nothing existing); closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.check_phone_number: Read-only diagnosis; open world because it may read the number's routing at the customer's carrier (read-only).
toolAnnotationJustifications.check_campaign: Read-only campaign diagnosis; closed world; PHI-gated like get_campaign_stats.
toolAnnotationJustifications.get_account_limits: Read-only limits and quotas; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.test_in_text: Not read-only: runs model calls for a simulated text conversation; free to the user and writes nothing; open world (model providers).
toolAnnotationJustifications.test_my_agent: Destructive: places billed simulated test calls (free test credit first) and may save generated scenarios; requires consent_to_charge; open world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.copy_webhook_endpoint: Not read-only: creates a webhook endpoint on another agent; idempotent (an existing copy is returned); not destructive; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.escalate_to_human: Not read-only: sends the summary to the ThunderPhone support team; open world (reaches people); not destructive.
toolAnnotationJustifications.request_feature: Not read-only: files a feature request with the ThunderPhone team; open world (reaches people); not destructive.
toolAnnotationJustifications.start_agent_import: Read-only: returns a dashboard link; takes no key; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.get_agent_import: Read-only import status; never returns the vendor key; closed world.
toolAnnotationJustifications.commit_agent_import: Not read-only: creates agents from a reviewed import; open world (reads the vendor platform with the key saved in the dashboard); not destructive.
